record.field: Liber: turn on the product image zoom

# Turn the product picture zoom on, matching RBC Industrial and Tooling. View = env["ir.ui.view"].sudo().with_context(active_test=False) on = ["website_sale.product_picture_magnify_hover"] off = ["website_sale.product_picture_magnify_click"] changed = [] for key, state in [(k, True) for k in on] + [(k, False) for k in off]: view = env.ref(key, raise_if_not_found=False) if view and view.active != state: view.write({"active": state}) changed.append("%s %s" % (key.split(".")[-1], "on" if state else "off")) action = { "type": "ir.actions.client", "tag": "display_notification", "params": {"title": "Product image zoom", "type": "success", "sticky": False, "message": ", ".join(changed) or "Already set as intended."}, }
